desc:
THIS! IS SPARTA!!!!!!
Dedicated to giving new Robloxians a classic Roblox game experience!

Duel over the hole with swords and fight to the death! Use the noob tube! Drive cars to the bottom and watch them explode! Ragdoll down the pit! Skydive to the bottom and reach where only the strongest players reside! Hear the classic OOF sound! And of course... PUSH DUMMIES DOWN THE SPARTA HOLE! 

Thank you all for playing over the years! Many of you have told me that this game is a part of your childhood, I'm very grateful to all of you that have played! You're all the reason I keep this game updated and working! :D

[VOICE ENABLED]

Credits:
